category: Open-Source Web Application Firewalls (WAF) & API Security Gateways

tools.name: BunkerWeb
tools.description: Next-generation open-source Web Application Firewall (WAF) and security gateway integrating OWASP CRS, fail2ban, bot detection, and automated TLS.
tools.tradeoff: Higher RAM overhead than single-binary C modules

tools.name: OWASP ModSecurity
tools.description: The industry-standard open-source web application firewall engine and OWASP Core Rule Set (CRS) enforcement library for Nginx and Apache.
tools.tradeoff: Legacy syntax complexity and manual compilation

tools.name: Coraza WAF
tools.description: OWASP Coraza is a 100% pure Go Web Application Firewall with native support for the OWASP Core Rule Set (CRS), Envoy proxy, and Caddy.
tools.core_win: 3.9k-star pure Go OWASP CRS WAF for Envoy/Caddy
tools.tradeoff: Go runtime garbage collection in ultra-high concurrency
